## transition

- `transition-focus-pull` (shader) The first picture falls out of focus into soft lens blur, its highlights opening into discs, and the next one is pulled sharp out of the blur. Loops back and forth; or turn Animate off and set Progress. Takes image, video, svg. Video: transition. Presets: Hard cut in the blur, Anamorphic, Dreamy. Tags: transition, cinematic, focus, blur, bokeh, lens, image, slideshow.
- `transition-flare-wipe` (shader) An anamorphic lens flare sweeps across the frame, its streak and bloom washing over the cut, and the next picture is left behind it. Loops back and forth; or turn Animate off and set Progress. Takes image, video, svg. Video: transition. Presets: Amber, Low and fast, White out. Tags: transition, cinematic, flare, lens, anamorphic, streak, wipe, image, slideshow.
- `transition-color-blocks` (shader) Bands of flat colour sweep across in staggered rows, covering one picture and uncovering the next behind them. Loops back and forth; or turn Animate off and set Progress. Takes image, video, svg. Video: transition. Presets: Clash, Single slab, Blinds, Diagonal, Ink and paper. Tags: transition, image, slideshow, blocks, band, wipe, flat, bold, recap, story.
- `transition-liquid-morph` (shader) Both images swept along a flowing, swirling current that peaks half way, dissolving one into the other like ink in water. Takes image, video, svg. Video: transition. Presets: Gentle, Turbulent. Tags: transition, morph, liquid, image, flow.
- `transition-displacement` (shader) Each image's brightness pushes it out in one direction as the next slides in, warped by its own light and dark. Takes image, video, svg. Video: transition. Presets: Upward smear, Subtle. Tags: transition, morph, displacement, image, warp.
- `transition-luma` (shader) Pixels switch to the next image in order of brightness, shadows first or highlights first, along a soft edge. Takes image, video, svg. Video: transition. Presets: Highlights first, Hard threshold. Tags: transition, morph, luma, image, dissolve.
- `transition-particle-swap` (shader) The image breaks into square particles that tumble along curved, staggered paths and land as the next image. Takes image, video, svg. Video: transition. Presets: Confetti, Tiles. Tags: transition, morph, particles, image, mosaic.
- `transition-ink-bleed` (shader) The next image bleeds through the first like wet ink on paper, spreading from a few seeds with dark, pooled edges. Takes image, video, svg. Video: transition. Presets: Sepia wash, Crisp. Tags: transition, morph, ink, watercolour, image, organic.
- `transition-whip-pan` (shader) A beat-cut whip pan or zoom punch: the first image flies off in a motion blur that peaks at the cut, and the next one lands from the other side. Takes image, video, svg. Video: transition. Presets: Whip left, Whip up, Zoom punch, Hard whip. Tags: transition, whip, pan, zoom, motion-blur, image, cut.
- `transition-pixel-dissolve` (shader) The picture pixelates up to big blocks, the blocks swap to the next image in a random order, then it resolves into the new picture. Loops back and forth; or turn Animate off and set Progress. Takes image, video, svg. Video: transition. Tags: transition, pixel, image, retro, 8-bit, slideshow.
- `transition-screen-melt` (shader) The classic shooter's screen melt: the old picture's columns slide down off the screen at ragged, staggered speeds, uncovering the next one.
